L15.title: Contract types and who carries the cost risk

items.d: Firm-fixed-price: one price, no matter what it costs the contractor. Most risk on the contractor, least administration.
Fixed-price with economic price adjustment: a fixed price that can move with set market changes, such as fuel or steel prices.
Fixed-price incentive: a target cost, target profit and ceiling price. A share ratio rewards coming in under target.
Cost-plus-incentive-fee: the Government pays allowable costs, and the fee moves with the cost results.
Cost-plus-award-fee: the Government pays allowable costs, and the fee is earned through a judgment of performance.
Cost-plus-fixed-fee: the Government pays allowable costs up to a ceiling, plus a fee set at award. Most risk on the Government.
